name: What is involved in the electrical fixture installation process with Frasheski Construction?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in the electrical fixture installation process with Frasheski Construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our electrical fixture installation process typically begins with a consultation to understand your needs and assess the existing electrical system. We then provide a detailed quote and timeline. Upon approval, our certified electricians will safely install the fixtures, ensuring all wiring is correct and meets safety standards. We conclude with a final check to confirm everything is working perfectly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process includes consultation, quote, safe installation by certified electricians, and a final check of functionality.
